title: Time Zone Conversion
instructions: Write the code to convert a London time to Tokyo time using the `zoneinfo` module. (The validation will check your code structure without executing the timezone conversion.)
steps: Define the London time zone object for `ZoneInfo('Europe/London')`. Store it in `london_tz`
Create an aware datetime object for 9:00 AM on July 10, 2025, in the London time zone. Store it in `london_meeting`.
Define the Tokyo time zone object for `ZoneInfo('Asia/Tokyo')`. Store it in `tokyo_tz`
Use the `.astimezone()` method to convert `london_meeting` to Tokyo time. Store the result in `tokyo_meeting`.
NOTE: You may see an error in the terminal because we are not actually importing the package for this exercise.

print(tokyo_meeting.hour)
solution:
# Step 1: Import datetime and ZoneInfo
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

# Step 2: Define London time zone
london_tz = ZoneInfo('Europe/London')

# Step 3: Create the aware datetime
london_meeting = datetime(2025, 7, 10, 9, 0, 0, tzinfo=london_tz)

# Step 4: Define Tokyo time zone
tokyo_tz = ZoneInfo('Asia/Tokyo')

# Step 5: Convert to Tokyo time
tokyo_meeting = london_meeting.astimezone(tokyo_tz)

# Step 6: Print the hour
print(tokyo_meeting.hour)
